description: up --runtime k8s applies namespace, Secret and resources, deletes what removed bricks left, and waits for each Deployment

commands: kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo delete deployment,service,configmap --selector app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=plugbricks,plugbricks/brick,plugbricks/brick notin (orders-api,postgres) --ignore-not-found
kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo rollout status deployment/orders-api-app --timeout=15s
kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo rollout status deployment/postgres-db --timeout=300s
kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo rollout status deployment/router --timeout=300s
